hero.lead: More than a destination. A place you come to know up close: its paths, its people, its own pace.

philosophy.label: The idea
philosophy.statement: You can visit a place and leave having seen only the view. Or you can live it: walk its paths, sit at its table, listen to its stories.
philosophy.aside: OurWay exists for the second kind of journey. For people who want to get to know a place, not just pass through it.

story.label: What you discover
story.title: A place is many things at once

blocks.title: The landscape is where it begins
blocks.body: Mountains, gorges, rivers, coastlines. The ground under your feet, light that shifts through the day, a kind of quiet the city never offers. Nature isn't a backdrop — it's the first thing that introduces you to a place.

blocks.title: What keeps a place alive
blocks.body: Feasts, dances, music, skills handed down through generations. Every region has its own way of living and remembering — and it's worth seeing up close, with respect.

blocks.title: Encounters outlast photographs
blocks.body: The shepherd in the meadow, the family at the café on the square, the craftsman in his workshop. You don't just see the people of a place — you talk with them.

blocks.title: An identity no guidebook can hold
blocks.body: The stone of the houses, the bridges, the hilltop chapels, the flavours. Everything that makes somewhere resemble nowhere else. That's what we look for, and what we want to share.

hero.title: Places with character
hero.lead: We're drawn to places with an identity — where nature, history and people still live side by side.

destinations.intro: Our specific destinations will be announced soon. Until then, these are the landscapes that draw us.

landscapes.title: Mountain villages
landscapes.body: Stone houses, squares shaded by plane trees, arched bridges and cobbled paths. Communities that still keep their own rhythm.

landscapes.title: Gorges and rivers
landscapes.body: Landscapes carved by water. Cool air, stone, greenery and a stillness that slows you down.

landscapes.title: Coastlines and cliffs
landscapes.body: The sea as people who live beside it know it — not just a beach, but a way of life.

landscapes.title: Plains and countryside
landscapes.body: Pastures, olive groves, small chapels. The rural life that shaped the land and its food.

destinations.ctaBody: Tell us where you'd like to go and what you'd like to experience there.

hero.title: Our way of getting to know a place
hero.lead: The name says almost everything. OurWay: the path we choose, and the way we walk it.

about.meaningTitle: The way is more than the route
meaningBody: Many people travel to see. We believe the real experience begins when you stop looking from a distance and step inside a place.
That's why OurWay doesn't simply plan routes from A to B. It plans time: time to understand where you are, who lives there and what this place has to tell you.

values.title: Authenticity
values.body: We show places as they are, not as a brochure would like them to be.

values.title: Respect
values.body: For nature, for local communities, for their traditions.

values.title: Connection
values.body: Between people, and between people and the place.

values.title: Curiosity
values.body: The urge to ask, to try, to discover something beyond the obvious.

about.natureCultureBody: In Greece, landscape and culture are inseparable. The paths were opened by people, the villages built from the mountain's own stone, the songs tell of the sea and the pastures. You can't truly know one without the other.
about.evolvingBody: OurWay is at its beginning. Our experiences, places and partnerships are taking shape step by step — carefully, and with people who share the same outlook.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.draftNotice: Interim text. The final privacy policy will be published after legal review.

sections.title: Data controller
sections.body: OurWay is responsible for your data. [Legal name, address, VAT number and contact email for data-protection questions — to be completed by OurWay.]

sections.title: What we collect
sections.body: Only what you give us in our forms. Contact form: name, email, message and — if you choose — phone, interest, date and number of people. Booking request or registration of interest: first and last name, email, phone, number of people, the date you chose and any message or special request you write. Tailor-Made request: the same contact details, plus destination, dates, budget and the preferences you describe. Please don't send us health information in free-text fields unless it is necessary for your safety on the activity.

sections.title: Why we use it
sections.body: To answer your request, check availability and organise the experience you asked for (steps prior to entering into a contract, at your request — Article 6(1)(b) GDPR). A booking request is not a confirmed booking: the OurWay team reviews it and contacts you. We don't use your data for advertising and we never sell it.

sections.title: Where it is stored
sections.body: Booking requests and Tailor-Made requests are stored in a database that only OurWay administrators can access. Contact-form messages are not stored on the website; they are delivered by email to the team. To run the website we use the processors Vercel (hosting), Supabase (database) and Resend (email delivery). [Data location and safeguards for any transfers outside the EU to be confirmed.]

sections.title: How long we keep it
sections.body: [The retention period for requests will be set by OurWay.] You can always ask us to delete your data sooner.

sections.title: Cookies and tracking
sections.body: The public website uses no advertising or analytics cookies and no third-party tracking tools. Only the private admin area uses a strictly necessary sign-in cookie for administrators.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict, port and object to the processing of your data. To exercise them, contact us through the contact page. You can also lodge a complaint with the Hellenic Data Protection Authority (www.dpa.gr).

hero.title: Tailor-Made Experiences
hero.lead: Not every journey needs to follow a fixed itinerary. Tell us what you have in mind and together we'll design an experience made entirely for you.

audience.label: Who we design for
audience.title: An experience for every group
audience.intro: From two people to whole teams: we shape the place, the pace and the activities around the people who will live it.

items.title: Private groups & friends
items.body: A getaway just for your group, at your own pace and built around your ideas.

items.title: Families
items.body: Experiences young and old enjoy alike, with safety, comfort and plenty of time outdoors.

items.title: Couples
items.body: A special day or a trip for two, far from the usual routes.

items.title: Corporate groups
items.body: Outings and team building that bring people closer, away from the office.

items.title: Organised groups
items.body: Clubs, schools and groups with shared interests — with the organisation a larger group needs.

items.title: Outdoor adventurers
items.body: Custom outdoor adventures designed around your level, your stamina and your ambitions.

kinds.label: What we can design
kinds.title: Not just hiking
kinds.body: Nature is where we start, not where we stop. We combine activities, places and people into an experience that is unmistakably yours.

steps.title: Tell us what you imagine
steps.body: Whatever you already know — or simply that you want to live something different. Nothing needs to be decided yet.

steps.title: We design it together
steps.body: We suggest a destination, itinerary and activities and shape them with you.

steps.title: You live it
steps.body: Once everything is agreed, we take care of the rest.

tailorMade.notBooking: A request is not a booking or a binding quote, and no payment is taken on the website. The itinerary, availability and price are shaped together with you.
